recorded_provenance.verification: Recorded from the original acceptance run; not verified against the current checkout/runtime by replay_command.

scope: Release and supplied-candidate replay only; parser/search E2E pending
overlay_policy: RFC 6902 add/remove on deep copy after verify_release. Counterfactual variants, not observations/new ratings. Keep original query/scope/rating bindings; case_id + overlaid_digest identifies variant. Never reseal as reviewed release.

b_search_boundary.command_owner: B #155/#48 must provide raw/parser -> actual bounded search -> ordered bindings -> adapter -> rank command per case. Replay command is not that command.
b_search_boundary.raw_prerequisites: Local data/raw/SEAMLESS matching snapshot manifest; no raw records committed. Synthetic regressions run without raw.

required_evidence: integrated revision/runtime/dependencies/input digests and time policy
original fact ledger plus overlay identity and graph delta if evidence withheld
actual generator caps/counters/truncation: active work budget=6; record max_paths/max_steps/max_expansions/timeout
ordered transition decisions: actor/target, exact observed edge IDs/locators, derived origins, failed/unknown predicates
ordered action/work IDs, full-history bounds and work basis, target asset/success event/first-goal trace
rational output, frontier/relations, Min-Effort + coverage; two deterministic runs and clean-checkout cross-reproduction
empty bounded result is not global no-path evidence
